name: Final 2421

origin.summary: An event from the 2024 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A descending thruster-and-chest-to-bar-pull-up couplet split around a heavy yoke carry in the middle.
